$comment: Benchmark data for the charts on diarist.dev/models/. Every number is copied from the file named in each block's `from` field; the website build fails if this file is missing or malformed. Published numbers are from leaderboards cited in docs/04; measured numbers are from docs/eval on the machine below.

asr_published.metric: average WER, percent, lower is better

asr_measured.from: docs/eval/2026-10-15-nemotron_en.md and docs/eval/2026-10-15-nemotron35.md (cpWER column of the transcript attribution tables); session names, minutes and groups from docs/05-eval-data.md and the same tables; the per-model summary is in docs/04-model-guide.md, section 3

sessions.name: AMI ES2002a
sessions.group: public AMI meeting, far-field mix, word-level reference

asr_measured.note: The Zoom sessions are the author's own meetings; their references are Zoom's machine transcripts with per-participant speaker labels, so cpWER there mixes recognition disagreement with attribution. AMI ES2002a has a hand-made word-level reference. The in-room stress session (Aug 14) is left out: its reference hides several people behind shared room devices, so its cpWER (44.7 and 44.3) measures the reference, not the models.
